assets.notes: Eligible for Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI) up to ₹7,00,000 under Form 5IF + PF Settlement Form 20 + Pension Form 10D.
Term Life Policy: Under Section 39 of Insurance Act, beneficial nominee receives immediate claim without legal heir contest.
Nominee registered. Claim can be settled within 15 days under RBI Master Circular without court intervention.
Requires inquiry on nomination status. If no nominee, indemnity bond required for claims under ₹5 Lakhs.
Centralized Transmission through KFintech / CAMS CAMSRep portal with transmission form.

tasks.title: Procure 15+ Original Municipal Death Certificates with QR Code
tasks.description: Every Indian bank, insurance company, EPFO, and registrar insists on viewing the original or retaining an attested physical copy. Municipal corporations issue multiple copies upon formal request.
tasks.statutoryReference: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969

tasks.title: Send Urgent Death Notification & EMI Moratorium Notice to HDFC Bank
tasks.description: Active NACH auto-debit of ₹46,500 is scheduled for the 5th of each month. Inward ECS bounces incur penalty charges and civil recovery notices. A formal death intimation freezes auto-debits.
tasks.statutoryReference: RBI Guidelines on Fair Practices Code for Lenders

tasks.title: Trigger Loan Protection Insurance (Sarv Suraksha / Home Shield)
tasks.description: The deceased had loan insurance linked to the home loan. Once triggered with the death certificate, the insurer pays the remaining ₹42,00,000 balance directly to HDFC Bank.

tasks.title: Intimate Employer HR & Submit EPFO Forms 20, 10D, and 5IF
tasks.description: Notify HR to process unpaid salary, gratuity, and submit joint attestation for EPFO claim. EDLI (Form 5IF) pays up to ₹7,00,000 to the nominee without any employee contribution.

tasks.title: Submit Nominee Survivor Claim at ICICI Bank
tasks.description: Nominee Pooja Sharma can submit claim form with death certificate and KYC. RBI circular mandates settlement within 15 calendar days.
tasks.statutoryReference: RBI Master Circular - Customer Service in Banks (Para 19)

tasks.title: Procure Surviving Member Certificate / Legal Heir Certificate from Tehsildar
tasks.description: Required for settling un-nominated assets, property transfers, and disputed claims. Apply via State e-District portal or local Revenue Officer.
